facts.fact: 赴约路上她复盘：George 不是一直这么暴躁——她归因于厨房里那场母子争吵。
facts.anchor: George wasn’t always so aggy, was he? I wouldn’t have hooked up with him if he was, let alone agreed to move in with him so quickly.

facts.fact: 中奖短信加地图蓝点把她带到 22 号门前。
facts.anchor: The blue dot confirms that this is exactly where I’m supposed to be. Well, roughly. I’m looking for number twenty-two.

facts.fact: 楼上那户没灯没活气、厚窗帘僵着——她断定通灵师不可能是顶楼。
facts.anchor: The top flat looks quite eerie. There are no lights on and no sign of life thanks to thick, faded cream curtains that look stiff in position.

facts.fact: 开门的是个苍白娇小的女人，栗红头发向后拢起——看着同龄，眼神却像多活了一千年。
facts.anchor: revealing a pale, petite woman with scraped up auburn hair.

facts.fact: 那个始终捏着的微笑——像钉在脸上而不是系上的面具。
facts.anchor: Like a mask that never slips because it’s stapled to a face instead of tied.

facts.fact: 通灵师不像她预想的 Mystic Meg，这反而让她放松，甚至觉得「温暖安全」。
facts.anchor: although she isn’t quite the Mystic Meg I was expecting, I think that’s the very reason I feel a lot more comfortable about doing this now.

facts.fact: Cassie 说可以录音；Blair 决定录——记性差，也想留给 George 听。
facts.anchor: ‘You can record this reading if you want. I don’t mind,’ she says as our eyes meet. Although, I get the feeling that she’d rather I didn’t.

facts.fact: Cassie 洗牌凌乱——Blair 眼里「她根本不知道自己在干嘛」。
facts.anchor: her movements are messy, chaotic. Like she doesn’t really know what the fuck she’s doing.

facts.fact: 慌乱之后她才自我介绍：Nova。
facts.anchor: ‘Oh, my God, I’m sorry. Where are my manners? I’m Nova, by the way.’
